subject: Request: one-time POC credit + 30-day sandbox extension for Meridian Health
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@meridianhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: POC runway and credits

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for the quick onboarding help last week. The team has run two full-data scenarios and the results are promising: latency targets are hitting production-like numbers and model outputs look good for our triage workflows. That said, we’re burning through the sandbox allocation faster than expected because we’re looping in additional clinician reviewers and running longer context traces.

Two asks from our side:
- Could Redwood provide a one-time token/credit uplift (we estimate ~150k tokens) to finish a final round of clinician validation?
- If possible, extend the sandbox window by 30 days so procurement can finish the PO and SOW review without us losing state.

I’ve attached the recent usage snapshot and a short summary of the tests. Procurement would prefer we keep any credit uplift tied to signing the SOW (we’re prepping a redline). If you need a formal request I can loop procurement in.

Attachments: [attachment: POC_usage_report.csv (CSV, 38 KB)]

Appreciate any flexibility — this POC is strategically important for our digital triage initiative.

Best,
Elena Park
Director, Clinical Innovation
Meridian Health

On Thu, Mar 8, 2028 at 08:50 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Elena — quick call now?
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC runway and credits

Elena —

Really glad to hear the tests are tracking well. We can be pragmatic here. I’m looping in Aditya (rev ops) and Marissa (head of deal desk) to evaluate a one-time uplift. To help speed the decision: can you confirm the acceptance criteria you need from this final validation and whether procurement requires any invoicing or PO milestones tied to the uplift?

We’ll attach the usage snapshot to our review. Tentative ask: 150k tokens + 30-day sandbox extension. If procurement wants a short amendment to the SOW that ties uplift to signature, we can draft that and route to DocuSign.

Attachment: [Meridian_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 210 KB) — for context] 

Thanks — I’ll escalate internally and aim to get a response by tomorrow EOD PST.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Team —

Quick read: Meridian is past the exploratory stage and this is a high-probability expansion (clinical workflow pilot across 3 hospitals). I’m comfortable approving a limited interim uplift from RevOps: we can grant 75k tokens today to keep momentum while Marissa reviews the one-time executive uplift for the remaining 75k + the 30-day extension. Conditions:
- Uplift is one-time and non-recurring.
- Meridian must sign or countersign the SOW redline within 30 days; we’ll attach the DocuSign link and milestone.
- For audit, Soojin please upload the usage report to the deal record in HubSpot.

If Marissa can approve the additional tokens and extension, we can close the loop today.

-aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: APPROVED: Meridian one-time uplift + 30-day sandbox extension

All —

Authorizing a one-time, non-recurring credit of 150,000 tokens and a 30-day sandbox extension for Meridian Health under the following conditions:
1) Meridian signs the attached SOW (Meridian_SOW_v2.pdf) or provides an agreed-upon amendment within 30 days.
2) Procurement provides a signed PO or confirms purchase order initiation by procurement@meridianhealth.com and copies procurement on the DocuSign envelope.
3) Usage will be reviewed after the uplift period; any suspicious or anomalous usage will be flagged and could be paused.

Soojin — please:
- Set the credit grant in our billing system as a one-off token allocation tied to deal RDW-2028-0557.
- Upload the POC_usage_report.csv to the HubSpot deal (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9876543) and attach the signed SOW when available.
- Confirm back to Elena and procurement once the credit is live.

Elena — pleased to hear this is moving quickly for you. Welcome Meridian — looking forward to the pilot results.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
Marissa.Cole@redwood.ai
